tier1.text: The occipital bone forms the back of the brain case, which holds and protects the brain. The occipital bone also forms part of the base of the skull. There, a large hole called the foramen magnum lets the spinal cord leave the skull. Oval knobs beside this hole hold the skull on top of the vertebral column, or backbone.

sentences.text: The occipital bone forms the back of the brain case, which holds and protects the brain.

quotes.quote: occipital bone: unpaired bone that forms the posterior portions of the brain case and base of the skull
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: brain case: portion of the skull that contains and protects the brain, consisting of the eight bones that form the cranial base and rounded upper skull
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The occipital bone also forms part of the base of the skull.

quotes.quote: The trapezoidal-shaped bone that forms the back and part of the base of the skull.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

sentences.text: There, a large hole called the foramen magnum lets the spinal cord leave the skull.

quotes.quote: On the base of the skull, the occipital bone contains the large opening of the foramen magnum, which allows for passage of the spinal cord as it exits the skull.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: foramen magnum: large opening in the occipital bone of the skull through which the spinal cord emerges and the vertebral arteries enter the cranium
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Oval knobs beside this hole hold the skull on top of the vertebral column, or backbone.

quotes.quote: On either side of the foramen magnum is an oval-shaped occipital condyle. These condyles form joints with the first cervical vertebra and thus support the skull on top of the vertebral column.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: vertebral column: series of separate bones joined together as a backbone
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.
